bullets.text: Agency channel represents majority of PL and CL policies; partnered with 35,000+ independent agents; 12-member Agency Council guides investments; Distribution team optimizing sales systems and organizational effectiveness.
Companywide Q1 CR was 88.8; Commercial Lines recorded an extraordinary CR of 83.6; Property posted a 97.9 CR; overall operational and investment results were stellar.
Companywide NPW +16% YOY for the quarter across all lines; Commercial Lines led product growth with NPW +26%; Property business delivered 19% NPW growth.

Total portfolio returned 3.2% (fixed income 2.3%, equities 13.3%); reversed $156M recorded tax benefit and wrote down $24M remaining investment, believing solar tax credit fund sponsor committed fraud.
Aggregate stop-loss reinsurance agreement prevented Property results from worsening by about 11 points on CR due to significant catastrophe activity and non-cat winter storms during the quarter.
Noted signals of a softening personal auto market alongside strong new policyholder conversion; will focus on efficient uses of increased marketing spend and maintain a surgical cost structure focus.
Agency-written 'Robinsons' (bundled auto and home customers) within Personal Lines grew 40% in Q1 compared to 2018; the company reported continuing strong new policyholder conversion.
#1 personal and commercial auto insurer by written premium in independent agency channel; ranked top personal lines carrier in agent satisfaction by J.D. Power’s 2019 Independent Agent Study.
Introduced agent-informed Portfolio quoting system, developed via agency focus groups and workflow observations to ease multi-product quoting and help agents offer additional customer protections.
Progressive Home tapped only ~2% of the bundled market, leaving long runway; plans Commercial Lines expansion leveraging a forthcoming business owners policy (BOP) offering.
